title: Profiteroles
description: Light choux pastry puffs filled with whipped cream and drizzled with warm chocolate ganache. Served with fresh fruit.

method.instruction: Bake choux puffs as per the choux pastry until golden and crisp. Cool completely on a wire rack.
Whip cream to soft peaks. Using a piping bag fitted with a small nozzle, fill each puff through a small hole in the base.
For the ganache: heat cream in a small saucepan until just simmering — do not boil. Place chopped chocolate in a heatproof bowl and pour the hot cream over it.
Let stand for 2 minutes, then stir gently until the chocolate is completely melted and the ganache is smooth and glossy.
Dip the top of each filled puff into the warm ganache, or drizzle generously over the top.
Serve immediately with fresh seasonal fruit on the side.

notes.title: Choux Pastry
notes.content: Refer to the Choux Pastry recipe in the Baking section for the pastry base. This recipe covers the assembly and finishing — the choux itself is a separate recipe component.

notes.title: Ganache
notes.content: Do not stir the ganache immediately after pouring the cream — letting it sit for 2 minutes allows the chocolate to melt evenly. Stirring too early can cause the ganache to split or become grainy.
